definitions.gloss: next time, next occasion, next installment
definitions.explanation: The next occurrence of a recurring event, meeting, episode, or session. Used for anything that happens in a series or cycle.

examples.japanese: {次回|じかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧です。
examples.english: The next session is next week.

examples.japanese: {次回|じかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please prepare the materials by the next meeting.

examples.japanese: {次回|じかい}⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{気|き}になった→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: After watching the preview for the next episode, I became very curious about next week's developments.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{次|じ} (next) + ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧ (time, round, occasion). Literally "the next round."

USAGE:
Often used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {次回|じかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (the next meeting). Also used without ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ in compound-like constructions: {次回|じかい}⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧ (preview of the next episode). Commonly seen at the end of TV shows, manga chapters, and serialized content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {次回|じかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: the next meeting
- {次回|じかい}⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧: preview of the next episode
- {次回|じかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from next time
- {次回|じかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧: to carry over to the next time
- {次回|じかい}⟦{以降|いこう}→以降：03999_ikou⟧: from the next time onward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧: this time
- ⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧: last time
- ⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧: every time
